name: oh-my-zsh

patches.old:
git init --quiet "$ZSH" && cd "$ZSH" \
  && git config core.eol lf \
  && git config core.autocrlf false \
  && git config fsck.zeroPaddedFilemode ignore \
  && git config fetch.fsck.zeroPaddedFilemode ignore \
  && git config receive.fsck.zeroPaddedFilemode ignore \
  && git config oh-my-zsh.remote origin \
  && git config oh-my-zsh.branch "$BRANCH" \
  && git remote add origin "$REMOTE" \
  && git fetch --depth=1 origin \
  && git checkout -b "$BRANCH" "origin/$BRANCH" || {
    [ ! -d "$ZSH" ] || {
      cd -
      rm -rf "$ZSH" 2>/dev/null
    }
    fmt_error "git clone of oh-my-zsh repo failed"
    exit 1
  }

scripts.checksum_source: locally-pinned upstream script at fixed commit

resources.checksum_source: locally-computed-pin from official HTTPS release; not independently authenticated publisher checksum

smoke: export ZSH="$OFFLINE_PREFIX/oh-my-zsh"; zstyle ":omz:update" mode disabled; plugins=(git); source "$ZSH/oh-my-zsh.sh"; alias gst | grep -q "git status"; autoload -Uz colors; colors; print -r -- omz-local-ok
notes: Fetches a complete pinned source tree in place of git network transport, preserving config generation and supported --unattended behavior. Explicit --verify-existing repeat mode accepts only the same pinned source marker; normal first-install overwrite protection remains upstream behavior.
Upstream installer is fetched at build time from a pinned commit. No upstream script snapshot is vendored in the skill.
